purpose: Concept evaluation only, not implemented. In-game examples are generated mockups, not native captures. Duplicate cyan bars in some scene illustrations are generation artifacts and should not be implemented.

prompts.A: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished professional concept sheet for UNIT OVERHEAD HUD ONLY, NOT screen HUD. Reference image in conversation is exclusively a visual style reference: 苔石精修, realistic dark finely grained moss stone, weathered thin bronze rims, restrained tiny ivy corner accent, ivory serif typography, muted emerald health and deep blue mana. Jungle ruins tower-defense game. Show a small blue robot hero standing on grassy jungle ruins floor, selected with a subtle olive ground ring. Immediately above its head a SMALL practical world-space HUD: level badge "12", health bar, mana bar. NO screen top bar, no action bar, no skills, no inventory, no minimap, no menus. The concept sheet has one large isolated 5x detail rendering of the overhead HUD on a dark stone background in upper half, and two lower in-game views showing that SAME overhead HUD at normal gameplay size and on three nearby units for crowd readability. The normal size HUD about 100-130 screen pixels wide, no giant floating placard. Design must be implementable as Godot UI, crisp consistent border, nested child bars must stay inside parent corners, health fill approx 72%, mana fill approx 48%, understated dark missing portion. Optional numerical health "720 / 1000" and mana "145 / 300" ONLY in enlarged detail, actual gameplay bars uncluttered. Tiny labels identify detail and in-game scale. One version per image. High-end AAA fantasy art direction but restraint and excellent legibility, restrained highlights, no neon, no sci-fi, no glass holograms, no excessive leaf clutter. Wide landscape concept sheet. Version A · 紧凑铭牌. A slim single horizontal dark stone capsule holding two stacked bars: upper emerald health 6px tall and lower blue mana 3px tall, thin bronze perimeter. A small rounded-square bronze stone level tile 12 at LEFT attached to the pair of bars. Shallow bevel, restrained moss on one outside corner. Clean horizontal silhouette and clear HP/MP separation. No unit name. Familiar compact readable design.
